visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with straight black hair and bangs stands in front of a neutral grey vertical-paneled wall. She wears a blue and purple patterned athletic jersey with dark red sleeves underneath and a white digital watch on her left wrist. She holds a silver medal with a red, white, and blue ribbon, smiling broadly at the camera with clear excitement. (2) The girl brings the silver medal closer to the lens, revealing a circular design with "桃園" (Taoyuan) printed in the center. Digital confetti overlays in various colors appear briefly across the screen to signify celebration. She points toward the medal with both index fingers while maintaining a joyful facial expression. (3) The girl continues to display the medal, at one point playfully biting the edge of it while laughing. She gives a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera. The camera remains mostly static at eye-level, capturing her enthusiastic movements and gestures as she talks to someone off-camera while holding the silver award.

Behind her, an upbeat electronic pop track plays with a steady 128 BPM kick drum and synth chords. The acoustic floor is clean. The girl giggles, creating a burst of percussive vocal energy. (3) The dialogue continues between the girl and the man; they discuss the city-level medal. The girl's speech rate is fast but clear, indicating high arousal. The BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic drive without pauses.
